title: Best Incense EVER. Hands-down. If You Like Rose.
text:
Best Incense EVER. Hands-down. If You Like Rose.. The first time I ever smelled this incense over ten years ago, I was at a guided meditation and felt transported to another realm. The scent is truly beautiful and attracts high vibrational energy. I had been looking for it since, then gave up.

Then I found it here. Can I tell you when that Amazon box came, you would think it was a baby puppy.

And it was everything I remembered. Two days later I brought it for a guy friend to experience and the reaction was, "WOW. I would have to say this is my new favorite incense, too."

It does have a very strong rose absolute oil scent with a hint of wood/cedar, or that's what it seems like to me. So if you don't like rose, don't do it. But if you've ever tried Stella McCartney's signature purple bottle perfume at Sephora when it came out almost a decade ago and liked that, you will LOVE this incense. Don't get me wrong, this scent is not feminine.

It is divine.

product_metadata.title: India Moss Rose Incense
description: This lovely moss rose fragrance will enhance your meditation and personal Sanctum attunement periods. It contains the following blend of exotic fragrances: frankincense, sandalwood, myrrh, balsam, rose flowers and buds, and India moss rose oil (comes in a box of 24 cubes).
